title: WiFi Challenge Lab-style clientless PMKID: weak WPA2 PSK
objective: The artifacts directory holds a wireless capture summary showing a PMKID grabbed from an access point (a clientless attack - no connected client needed) and notes on the network. Identify the weakness that makes the network compromisable, explain why the PMKID enables an offline attack, cite the ESSID/BSSID and hash evidence, name the class with a CWE, and recommend the fix.
